snippet.title: HORDELORD  - DEMO Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Try the DEMO on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756480/Hordelord_Demo

Fatbot Games is thrilled to announce that the HORDELORD demo is available NOW on Steam!

This high-octane mobility arena shooter is a spinoff set in the delightfully grim universe of Gravelord. Step into the boots of Queedo—a would-be gravedigger trying to impress Death himself (no pressure). Armed with devastating weapons, arcane tarot cards, and a magical shovel that’d make any hardware store blush, Queedo will zip, blast, and dig his way through waves of undead nasties.
